verdict.rationale: The evidence shows data-sharing controls next to the story's subject, but nothing on telemetry itself. Semgrep analyzes code locally and never uploads it by default (semgrep-gh-2), the `--dry-run` flag keeps scan results from being uploaded to the web app (semgrep-docs-33/51), and no login is needed to scan (semgrep-docs-34). None of this documents an opt-out for usage telemetry or metrics. Missing for 10: an explicit telemetry/metrics opt-out flag or setting, documentation of what usage data is collected, and independent confirmation that opting out works.
